THE SAME PARTY'S SECOND ROW ON THE SAME DAY, AND THE FIRST OIL SOLD SINCE 26 AUG. 5 unit for RM65, RM13 a unit, collected and paid. RM13 is exactly the rate on the 10-unit rung of the oil board and the rate CZ4-MK paid on 26 Aug, so the per-unit figure is the house rate; what is unusual is the size, since 5 unit is not a rung the board shows. It sits RM2.70 UNDER the 5-unit collected floor of RM67.70, which the board's own taper explains rather than excuses: the floor rises faster than the rate below 10 unit. Costed at RM7.67 from the 30-unit lot of 26 Aug, so it returns RM26.67 at 41.0%. Same R3 leg as the salt row, credited at this row's own size.

HIS FIRST ORDER, AND THE SECOND LARGEST SINGLE SALE ON THE BOOK. 6 unit for RM440, RM73.33 a unit, paid and delivered in full on the day. The per-unit rate reads low beside the RM100 anchor and is not: the floor tapers with size, so 6 unit collected asks about RM338.59 and RM440 clears it by roughly RM101. It returns RM140 at 31.8% on the RM50 shelf lot. He has been on the roster without a row until today. Handover is not stated, so the field is left unset: the share of orders delivered is measured over the rows that say, and a row that was never asked must stay distinguishable from one that answered.

SOURCING_PLAN.note: THE 100 UNIT TIER WAS THE RECOMMENDATION AND HE HAS TAKEN THE 50. Landed cost is RM45.20 a unit against RM43.60, so this lot costs RM80 more than the same salt bought at the top tier, and it covers about a fortnight rather than three weeks. RM4,360 would have fitted the ceiling with RM140 to spare. Recorded as his call, not as an error.

lock.why: RE-LOCKED v244 on the same 28 Jul lot, at the 06 Aug count. The lot has not changed; what changed is the leak behind it and the attribution in front of it. The 33.14 count took the observed rate from 16.19% to 18.87%, and SHRINK_ATTRIB went to 1, so the whole leak is now carried in the price and nothing is absorbed. Effective cost RM53.19 to RM60.01. These numbers are the unlocked path’s own output, captured rather than hand-computed: the lock was deleted, pxCost() run fresh at attrib 1, and the result written back here. Absorbed is 0 by definition at full attribution.
